Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class WaitlistRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.WaitlistRepository
public class WaitlistRepository extends Object
Repository for the Firestore 'waitlist' collection. All reads and writes to waitlist documents flow through this class.

The Sprint-8 resolution model is instant: when a counselor creates a slot, the system automatically books it for the first matching waitlisted student (FIFO). There is no intermediate "offer-and-accept" step.

  • Method Details

    • joinWaitlist

      public void joinWaitlist(WaitlistEntry entry, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistActionCallback callback)
      Adds a student to a counselor's waitlist unless an active duplicate exists.

      A duplicate is defined as an entry with the same studentId, counselorId, and status == ACTIVE. Students are allowed to re-join after cancellation.

      Parameters:
      entry - The waitlist entry to persist (should have preference fields set).
      callback - Three-way result: success, already-waitlisted, or failure.

    • resolveEntry

      public void resolveEntry(String entryId, String slotId, String appointmentId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistSimpleCallback callback)
      Atomically resolves a waitlist entry — marks it RESOLVED and records the slot and appointment that fulfilled it.
      Parameters:
      entryId - The waitlist entry to resolve.
      slotId - The slot ID that matched the entry's preferences.
      appointmentId - The appointment booked for the student.
      callback - Success/failure callback.

    • cancelEntry

      public void cancelEntry(String entryId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistSimpleCallback callback)
      Cancels an active waitlist entry. Called when a student withdraws their request.
      Parameters:
      entryId - The Firestore document ID of the entry to cancel.
      callback - Success/failure callback.

    • getAllWaitlistForStudent

      public void getAllWaitlistForStudent(String studentId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistLoadedCallback callback)
      Loads all waitlist entries (active, resolved, and cancelled) for a student. Used by StudentWaitlistActivity to display the full request history.
      Parameters:
      studentId - The student's Firebase Auth UID.
      callback - Receives all entries on success.

    • getActiveWaitlistForStudent

      public void getActiveWaitlistForStudent(String studentId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistLoadedCallback callback)
      Loads only ACTIVE waitlist entries for a student. Used by StudentHomeActivity to show the waitlist status card count.
      Parameters:
      studentId - The student's Firebase Auth UID.
      callback - Receives active entries on success.

    • getActiveWaitlistForCounselorOrdered

      public void getActiveWaitlistForCounselorOrdered(String counselorId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistLoadedCallback callback)
      Loads active waitlist entries for one counselor, sorted by requestedAt ascending (FIFO order). Used by CounselorWaitlistActivity and the auto-resolution hook in AvailabilitySetupActivity.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - The counselor's Firebase Auth UID.
      callback - Receives FIFO-sorted active entries on success.

    • getActiveWaitlistForCounselor

      public void getActiveWaitlistForCounselor(String counselorId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistLoadedCallback callback)
      Loads active waitlist entries for one counselor (unordered). Kept for backward compatibility with callers that only need the list, not FIFO order.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - The counselor's Firebase Auth UID.
      callback - Receives active entries on success.

    • getActiveWaitlistCountForCounselor

      public void getActiveWaitlistCountForCounselor(String counselorId, WaitlistRepository.OnWaitlistCountCallback callback)
      Returns the count of ACTIVE waitlist entries for a counselor. Used by CounselorDashboardActivity to populate the stat card.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - The counselor's Firebase Auth UID.
      callback - Receives the count on success.
